description: This file defines the OAuthClientController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling OAuth client-related functionality in the Controller namespace. It inherits from AbstractVueController and sets up a Vue component with properties related to OAuth clients during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: OAuthClientController
classes.description: Controller class for managing OAuth client data within the OrangeHRM OAuth module. Extends AbstractVueController to handle Vue-based front-end interactions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with OAuth client data before rendering, adding a property for unselectable client IDs.
